source_name: Base Sirene des entreprises et de leurs établissements (SIREN, SIRET)
organization: INSEE (Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques)
approx_size: StockUniteLegale ~960 MB zip; StockEtablissement ~2.83 GB zip
data_freshness: Stock files rebuilt monthly (01 of month); updates available daily via API
notes: Authoritative national business register. ~25M legal units / ~36M establishments. NOT downloaded here due to size (note before ingesting). Use stable landing page to resolve current dated URLs for automation.

Official daily-updated API. Requires free account on portail-api.insee.fr + subscription to obtain API key. Best for incremental/daily diff ingestion. Supports multi-criteria, phonetic and historical queries.

organization: DINUM (Direction interministérielle du numérique) / Annuaire des Entreprises
license: Open (public service); underlying data ODbL / Licence Ouverte
notes: No-auth, easiest to start with. Aggregates INSEE Sirene + INPI RNE + dirigeants + others into one Elasticsearch index. Verified working 2026-06-06. ALSO exposes an open 'finances' block per company (ca = revenue, resultat_net = net income, keyed by year) derived from non-confidential INPI comptes annuels - verified live 2026-06-14 (SIREN 356000000 LA POSTE -> 2024 ca 34569000000, resultat_net 1722000000). Great for lookups/enrichment + headline financials; not a bulk dump path.

source_name: INPI RNE - Comptes annuels (annual accounts / financial statements)
organization: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle)
bulk_download_url: SFTP server (credentials issued after free registration)
license: Open data (INPI conditions of reuse); non-confidential filings only
data_freshness: Daily; filings since 2017-01-01; JSON format since 2023
notes: OPEN full annual-accounts data (balance sheet + income statement + fixed assets/depreciation/provisions) for NON-CONFIDENTIAL filings since 2017. Bulk via SFTP + RNE API after free account. The path to full statements beyond the Recherche API's ca+resultat_net. Coverage partial: micro/small firms may file confidential accounts (excluded).

Opendatasoft catalog of company documents/accounts deposits (links + metadata, incl. confidentiality). Useful for discovery and to locate comptes annuels filings; the structured figures themselves come from INPI RNE. Open Licence 2.0, no auth.

source_name: RNE - Registre National des Entreprises (Data INPI)
organization: INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle)
bulk_download_url: SFTP server (credentials issued after free registration)
license: Open data (free of charge); terms per INPI conditions of reuse
notes: Authoritative legal-identity register (successor to RCS centralization). Richer legal data than Sirene (capital, dirigeants, beneficial owners, acts, annual accounts since 2017). Bulk via SFTP after free account. Beneficial ownership (RBE) access is restricted/regulated.

source_name: BODACC - Bulletin officiel des annonces civiles et commerciales
organization: DILA (Direction de l'information légale et administrative)
notes: ~49.4M announcement records. Events stream: creations, modifications, radiations, procédures collectives, dépôts de comptes, ventes/cessions. Excellent for change-detection / lifecycle events, not a full company master list. Verified working 2026-06-06.

fields_observed: aggregated administrative data, attestations, mandataires sociaux, comptes
notes: Reserved for public administrations and authorized private bodies (habilitation/legal mission). NOT open to general reuse. Notably brokers DGFIP chiffres d'affaires (last 3 years) and Banque de France bilans (last 3 years) - richer/authoritative financials than the open sources, but restricted. Listed for completeness; do not rely on for general ingestion.
